changelog:
Testing Build (vc19-0210) vs Testing Build (vc20-0210)

Fixes

- Updater final state now reads "DONE (PatchFix=vc20-0210)" instead of "DONE (versionCode=20)". Note: the updater script that runs is the one installed before the update, so the new format appears from the update after this one (20 -> 21).

Changes

- Upgrade progress log polished: the download URL is no longer printed on the first line and the messages were rewritten for a cleaner, professional reading (state transitions, download, checksum, backup, extract, resync, container propagation, restart).

- README: new "Updates & Versioning" section explaining the Channel/PatchFix scheme - what the channel, the vc number and the DDMM build date mean, including multiple patches sharing the same day - plus updated status and feature lists (unidirectional nodes, per-instance logs, Stacks/Backups pages enabled).
